details:
So, I imagine there's some standards set by casio, but you gotta give us -something- for the price. 

Like these are better than the booth g-shock because official, no needing OSC apps, and cheaper ($18 for the booth one). 

But, I have a fewsmall notes.

 First,

 it can be hard to make it fit your avatar with scaling locked to all-3-or-nothing. I think you should unlock all 3 scale angles because wrists are not all the same shape. 

Second, 

I think the color picker option should be applied to them, but I imagine casio said no to that idea, so I understand. 

Third,

 The time displaying your time is great, but I feel it should display your time on -only- yours.  

My friend in the picture (green watch) is in EST, I am in CST. 

If i look at his watch it should be a 1 hour difference, not my time. 

I very much like that we get a watch instead of the time in the VRC menu, and this will even keep me from looking at XS-overlay to see what time it is, but I would prefer it if people could look at my watch, and see -my- time, not theirs. Basically, timezone differences . 

"Oh wow it's 4 AM for you, go the heck to bed,boy!"
title: I feel the g-shock needs some small changes.
